news.headline: Saints RB Travis Etienne Jr. to sit with hamstring injury
news.detail: Saints running back Travis Etienne Jr. will miss time with a hamstring injury suffered in Sunday's loss to the Raiders. New Orleans coach Kellen Moore did not specify how long Etienne will be out.
